name: Boston Dynamics Spot
src: 14 kg payload and $75,000 from comparison sites; 30 cm step unverified
notes: MuJoCo Menagerie simulator model (no open CAD). Outline, mass, standing height, the support rectangle (the feet) and the mounts ('top' on the trunk, 'front' front_inset_m behind the trunk's nose) are read from the model in its 'home' keyframe when the composer loads the card. Treated as non-holonomic: it must turn to go through a doorway, so the Turn check uses its length.
